clauses.reason: Terminated by its own terms. Section 1-105 provides that the Board terminates on December 31, 1981, unless sooner extended. The stated day is recorded inclusively, so the order is treated as running through the end of December 31, 1981 and the first end is dated 1981-12-31; on the exclusive reading (the order ends when that day begins) the end falls on 1981-12-30, disclosed for the reviewer (owner ruling 2026-10-21, until-dates). No extension is held: the packet’s number-citation lookup found no held text citing this order by number, and a name search of the held order texts for the Board found only its own printings, the American Presidency Project copy and the table of EO 12553. The rest of the clause establishes a 15-member National Advisory Community Investment Board under section 704 of the Economic Opportunity Act of 1964, assigns its functions as that section provides, directs the Community Services Administration Director to give administrative support, and assigns the Federal Advisory Committee Act functions of the President to that Director. All of it is time-limited by the same sunset. Executive Order 12553 of February 25, 1986 later revoked the order by number (the table lists 12254, whose subject line describes establishing the National Advisory Community Investment Board); it is a later event because the order had already ended. No earlier end was found.
